plot: The day after the storm it is Pip's birthday and nobody seems to remember: bubbly Bertha rushes off with a soap bubble on her roof and Bolt hurries by with a 'boring' box, so guilty Turbo takes Pip on a birthday ride to her favourite car wash, where Grumpy blocks the doors for a 'private party' and Pip, feeling left out, almost goes home; at three the doors open on a surprise party that Grumpy secretly planned all week, Turbo turns out to have brought Pip at exactly the right time by accident, the foam machine overflows onto the cake and everyone laughs; lesson: when you feel left out, tell a friend; then Bolt's present is a driving lesson up the big Wheelburg Hill, all by herself.

script.title: Did Everyone Forget Pip's Birthday?

set.place: Wheelburg car wash and the street outside, sunny afternoon after the storm

script.description: It's Pip's birthday and everyone seems too busy for her. Inspector Bolt #16

beats.say: Turbo, wait! It's my birthday! Did everyone really forget?
Forget? Us? No way! We... um... ohhh no.
It was the day after the storm. Pip's birthday.
And nobody had said a single word to her.
Not one card. Not one honk. Not even a happy beep.
I was up all night with Grumpy! Puddle practice!
I'm so sorry, Pip. I forgot too.
Then Big Bertha came rolling by. Very fast. And very bubbly.
Bertha! Do you know what day it is?
Tuesday? No, Wednesday! I'm busy, busy, sweetie! Bye-bye!
Why is there a soap bubble on your roof?
Bubble? What bubble? I'm blowing... I mean, going! Bye!
And Bertha zoomed away. With the bubble still on her roof.
She forgot too. Everybody forgot.
Not everybody! I remember! Now! Very much!
Pip, I'm making this the best birthday ever. Starting right now!
How? You don't have a present. You don't have a cake.
I have something better. A birthday ride! Follow me!
A ride? Just us two? Okay. That's a little bit nice.
Turbo drove carefully. Like a real crossing guard now.
Then they passed Inspector Bolt, carrying a big wrapped box.
Bolt! What's in the box? Is it for somebody special?
This? Official police business. Very boring. Good morning, Pip.
And Bolt hurried off. Bolt never hurried.
Even Bolt is too busy for me today.
Bolt said boring. Bolt never says boring. Hmm.
Don't be sad. Turbo's birthday ride is the best ride in town!
Okay. But no zooming. You're a crossing guard now.
Where are we even going?
Your favourite place in the whole wide world!
The car wash? You remembered I love the car wash?
Of course! You say it every day! 'Bubbles are my favourite!'
So they drove to the Wheelburg car wash.
The big blue one, with the giant spinny brushes.
But the doors were shut. And Grumpy was parked right in front.
Closed. Private party. Go away.
A party? Today? And I'm not invited?
Grumpy! It's Pip's birthday! Let her in for one wash!
Not yet. Rules are rules. Come back at three o'clock.
Three o'clock? That's in one minute. I'll just go home.
Pip turned around. Her little headlights looked very wet.
Pip, don't go! Please! Just wait one minute with me!
Why? So I can watch everybody have fun without me?
No! Because... I don't know why. But I have a feeling.
Behind the doors, somebody whispered very loudly.
Is she here? Is she here?
I can't hold my honk much longer!
Wait. That was Bertha's voice. Inside the car wash?
Hmph. Ten seconds. Nine. Eight. Oh, forget it.
Grumpy rolled aside. And the big blue doors opened.
Happy birthday, Pip! We remembered! We remembered all along!
You... you remembered? But everyone was so busy!
Busy hiding a party. Hardest case of my career.
I almost told you three times! My honk was so itchy!
And guess who planned it all? For a whole week?
Who? You, Bertha?
Nope! Grumpy!
Don't make a big thing of it. I have a reputation.
That's why you said that last night! You were planning this!
And Turbo! You brought her right at three! Perfect timing!
Yes. I totally knew. I planned it all.
Okay. I didn't know. I just brought her to the bubbles.
I thought nobody cared. I almost went home all alone.
Next time you feel left out, tell a friend.
We always, always want to know.
I will. Feeling forgotten is easier when you say it out loud.
Enough talking. Bubble time. I pressed the big red button.
Foam poured out. Big foam. Bigger foam. A whole mountain of foam.
Oh no! The cake! The cake is wearing a foam hat!
Foam cake! It's the best cake I ever saw!
Case closed. It is now officially a bubble cake.
Everyone splashed and spun and slid. Even Grumpy did one tiny spin.
That spin never happened. Nobody saw it.
I saw it! It was a lovely spin, Grumpy!
Thank you, everybody! This is my best birthday ever!
Happy birthday, Pip! From your new crossing guard!
One more thing, Pip. My present. The box was for you.
Pip opened the box. Inside was a little card with a map.
Tomorrow you learn to drive up the big hill. All by yourself.
The big hill? By myself? Um... is it very, very steep?
What do you think Bolt will find next time? We'll find out in the next episode!
